prompt:
Build a real-time full-stack chat application using Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

The application should allow multiple users to join a common chat room and exchange messages instantly in real time.

Frontend Requirements:

* Use ONLY:

  * index.html
  * style.css
  * app.js
* Create a modern responsive chat UI.
* Include:

  * username input section
  * join chat button
  * chat message area
  * online status/header
  * message input field
  * send button
* Messages should appear instantly without page refresh.
* Differentiate own messages and other users' messages visually.
* Auto-scroll to latest message.
* Show timestamps beside messages.
* Show join/leave system notifications.

Backend Requirements:

* Use Node.js + Express + Socket.IO only.
* Backend should:

  * create server
  * handle socket connections
  * broadcast messages
  * track connected users
  * emit join/leave events
  * support multiple clients simultaneously
* Use port 3000.

Functional Requirements:

* When user enters username and joins:

  * establish socket connection
  * notify all users
* When message is sent:

  * emit to server
  * broadcast to all connected users
* Prevent empty messages.
* Handle disconnect events properly.

Architecture Rules:

* Frontend and backend must be separated cleanly.
* Keep logic modular.
* Do not generate unnecessary files.
* No React.
* No Vite.
* No database.
* No authentication system.
* No external UI libraries.

Expected Folder Structure:
project/
├── backend/
│   ├── server.js
│   └── package.json
├── frontend/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── style.css
│   └── app.js

Extra Requirements:

* Automatically serve frontend using Express static middleware.
* Frontend should open directly on:
  [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)
* Add proper console logs throughout backend for debugging:

  * user connected
  * user disconnected
  * message received
  * server started
* Code must be fully working without placeholders or TODO comments.
* Generate clean readable production-style code.
